Record your screen with your camera and voice. When you finish, the app transcribes on your computer and your own AI writes notes, a YouTube script, titles, a description with chapters and subtitles. Nothing is uploaded to any server.
textos.Graba usa la IA que ya tienes, con tu cu: Graba uses the AI you already have, with your account. We test it with a short question.
textos.Más rápido y pequeño; para Macs con poca: Faster and smaller; for Macs with little memory.

textos.Si siempre hablas en el mismo, elegirlo: If you always speak the same one, choosing it improves the transcription.
textos.Todo se procesa en tu computador. La IA: Everything is processed on your computer. The AI uses your own account.
